name: orchestrate
description: Coordinates parallel subagents through Beads-backed DAGs, claims, threaded replies, decisions, review, and merge state. Supports exact, specialist, generic-pull, writable-fallback, and read-only research dispatch. Bundles coder (with effort-tier variants), researcher, reviewer, advisor, shepherd, and scribe. Quality triage roles (docs-guard, lint-guard, data-metrics-summarizer, maintenance-metrics-reader, reviewer-mechanics) come from the agent-quality-guards dependency. Includes deterministic scope, discovery, claim, message, decision, queue, and conflict scripts plus shared PR shepherd landing safeguards. Requires the bd CLI.
